target_customer: Creators and marketers making AI video and paid social ads
problem: Professional AI video needs many generations and several tools to edit; Latted combines generation, editing and ad research in one place.
business_model: Credit-based subscription for AI video creation (free trial of 5 credits per YC page)
product_category: AI video studio and ad creative engine

founders.name: Emre Gucer
education: Northwestern University (former student, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as co-founder and CEO of Fume.

founders.name: Metehan Oz
education: New York University (former student, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as co-founder and CTO of Fume.

technical_complexity.rationale: Stitching third-party video, image and voice models into a long-form editor is moderate engineering with timeline tooling as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Built on third-party models; competitors including Runway, Pika and other YC W24 video startups offered similar tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; model providers kept adding editing features.

market_need_then: Company says thousands of creators used Latted for marketing and educational videos (company claim, 2024 YC description).

identity.voice_and_tone: Product-focused: AI content engine for organic video and paid ads.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand was found.

pivots.from: All-in-one AI video generation and editing (2024 description)
pivots.to: AI video studio for paid social ads with ad research and daily creative production

outcome_analysis: Latted is listed as active with two founders and no funding found. Its pitch narrowed from general AI video to paid ad creative, and the founders are also associated with Fume, a separate developer tool, so focus may have split. Evidence of traction or an outcome is thin.
notes: Funding searches found no data; unknown, not zero. Relationship between Latted and Fume is unconfirmed beyond the YC page naming the founders as Fume co-founders. Website fetch returned only a title. The pivot is inferred from the difference between the 2024 description and the current YC page and is not stated by a source. Competitor search returned 2024 YC W24 video startups but no dated competitive comparison, so the list is empty.
